title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
description: Today: Apple's iOS 27 brings the public debut of Siri AI while Meta reshapes its AI workforce; Barnaby Joyce defends One Nation's net-negative migration plan against economist warnings; Queensland's bail law overhaul draws heavy criticism from legal and advocacy groups; and a new study names the Gold Coast Australia's most exposed city to rising sea levels. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
